correctness.rationale: For every t>0, γ>0, α≥0, H equal the central average of the 3 left transpositions on C[S3], and Φ the corresponding conjugation-average channel, their commutation yields classical convolution with the unitary central spectral distribution. S3 characters give ξ=e^(−2γt)(1+2cos²αt)/3, η=e^(−γt)(1+2cosαt)/3; exact inversion gives D=(|ξ+4η|+3ξ+2|ξ−2η|)/12. Piecewise derivatives on c∈[−1,1] have signs negative, negative, positive, so unique optimal cosine c*=(2−sqrt(4+4x−2x²))/(2x)∈(−1/2,0), min D=x²(1+2c*²)/6, asymptotic coefficient 1/4, no exact mixing since ξ>0. Infinitely many α map to that cosine. Independent 6×6 spectral classical/quantum propagation matched 24 (x,c) cases (finite corroboration, not continuum uniqueness proof).
